name: Crook of the Ancient Serpent
source: Osirion, Land of the Pharaohs pg. 31
body:
Source Osirion, Land of the Pharaohs pg. 31
Aura strong divination, evocation, and necromancy CL 13th
Slot hand; Price 70,000 gp; Weight 5 lbs.
Description
This curved and striped staff of office has all the powers of a rod of withering and a rod of enemy detection. It can also store one offensive spell as if it were a weapon with the spell storing property.
Construction
Requirements Craft Magic Arms and Armor, contagion, true seeing, creator must be at least 12th level; Price 35,000 gp, 3,000 XP
